grammar.summary: 本课学习反身代词与身体受伤表达。

points.title: 反身代词
points.explanation: myself/yourself/himself/herself/ourselves/themselves，动作反身：I fell down and hurt myself. 主语与宾语同一人时必须用反身代词。

examples.en: I slipped and fell downstairs. I hurt my back.
examples.cn: 我滑倒摔下了楼，伤了背。

points.title: help oneself
points.explanation: help + 反身代词 = 请自便：Help yourself to the food.（招待用语）。

examples.en: Stand up! Can you stand up?
